entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You hear that!? Those are the voices of[n]the humans you made fun of!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: No one wants you to rule over them![n]Isn't that right, [fName]!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Why do they gotta word it like they're[n]lookin' down on us?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: But, they're cheering for us...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Heh... Doesn't feel bad...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: They don't have to tell us twice...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We won't let ourselves be erased!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We're going all out, dammit!

entries.speaker: Yaldabaoth
entries.en: God is the one who creates the world!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I've made up my mind.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I will see my justice through for the sake[n]of protecting what I care about.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Morgana...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...The same goes for you guys too!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: If you've decided to take the world from[n]him, don't compromise your ideals to[n]the very end!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Let's defeat him together!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey, god. Foolish humans are prayin'[n]down there.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: They're prayin' there's no place for[n]someone like you in this world!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Give that evil god his final warning,[n][fName]!
We're saving this world.
You messed with the wrong thieves.
